title: Code for the hybrid IMB2 + 4D-Var CrIS NH3 inversion
description: Code behind the ERL paper on the hybrid IMB2 + 4D-Var inversion of NH3 emissions with CrIS retrievals and the CMAQ adjoint: the CMAQ adjoint (NH3 version), a snapshot of the py4dvar framework, and the IMB2 mass-balance code with the driver for the production run.
